paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.111a.3): Rav Ashi challenged it—or, some say, Rav Shmuel of Zrokinya.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Chullin gives the objection as Rav Ashi’s, or alternatively Rabbi Shmuel of Zrokinya’s. Hyman writes Rav for Shmuel.
